svg.title: Boolean solver calls: F4 and F5

cc:Work.dc:title: Boolean solver calls: F4 and F5
cc:Work.dc:description: Shared K_1 / 2^17 m=2 workload, 16 Boolean variables, four planted and four random targets, maximum degree 3. The solve_boolean_system entry point, including root readback.
